title: Dr Anan (clinician, Kesaro, Taifafeki)
description: Persona: a Taifafeki clinician in Kesaro who gives Somsak's Hep B and BCG birth doses and prints the two signed DVCs (J1), and who sees him again a year later at a primary care clinic, reading his record through the VHL (J4.1). Fictional.

persona.name: Dr. Anan
persona.goal: Give a non-Taifafeki baby proper care, at birth and when he returns.
needs: A way to issue records that travel with the family
A child's full history at the point of care
frustrations: No national ID to attach records to
Records from abroad he cannot read or verify
